description:
A lowered value is an open map: documented with 4 fields (compiler.ex ~L1687), 17 keys in practice, built by `val/3` plus 21 literal `%{c: ...}` constructions. Two of its properties are substring tests on the C string, written twice each: "can this C raise" (`may_raise?` ~L1767 and `check_free?` ~L5663, `c` contains "ctx") and "is this C a copy" (`Regex.run ~r/^defk_copy_/` ~L1498 and `String.starts_with?(c, "defk_copy_")` ~L6535).

This reopens the x3a.6 decision to keep `may_raise?` as a text rule; the owner agreed on 2026-10-19 with this shape:
- `val/3` derives `raises?` and `copy?` from the C once, so the text rule has one home and stays total; the 21 literal constructions go through `val/3`.
- Readers (`may_raise?`, `check_free?`, the two copy sites, `same_c?` where it only asks these) read the fields.
- Second step, only if the ticket finds that every raising site already goes through a few emitters (`checked/1`, `flagged_check/1`, the ctx-taking builtins): those emitters set `raises?` and the derivation becomes an assertion.
- `pure_read` stays as it is (a different question).

Tests: select_test ~L173-191 and tuple_branch_test ~L192-207 grep `_s(&` and `v_cond_ ?` (8 lines) although `:branch` is a report topic; point them at `notes/3` where the decision is the subject.

Gate: byte-identical `mix dump_c`; `mix ci`; PR per AGENTS.md. Update the value doc comment and the compiler map's "expressions" row.

comments.text: Finding: a raises?/copy? field derived in val/3 is unsound. A value's C is wrapped after construction at 13 sites (as_u64/1, with_binds/2, the u64/i64 conversions, the checked arithmetic), so a field set at construction goes stale; and 102 lines emit raising C, so declaring it at the emitters (option a) is the x3a.6 risk again. Delivered instead: the one home for each text rule. may_raise?/1 is the ctx rule and check_free?/1 now asks it; the copy form is copy_expr/2, read back only by copy_parts/1 (assign_copy, note_copy), where loop_owned built it and two sites parsed it. The six base constructions go through val/3; the value doc lists every optional key and its setter. select_test and tuple_branch_test read the :branch notes for the decision and keep one C-form check each.
PR #59; C unchanged; mix ci green (2294 passed).

title: A lowered value declares raises? and copy?; val/3 is the one constructor
